system.description:
Grants the ability to hide from a particular sense or detection technique.
Level 1: Hide from one minor sense
Level 2: Hide from one common sense
Level 3: Hide from multiple senses
Level 4: Undetectable to 4 senses or techniques
Level 5: Undetectable to 5 senses or techniques
Level 6: Undetectable to 6 senses or techniques
